items.title: 61539_Butter Jackson oral history interview
items.q: I knew Elton Hill when he was with Tommy [Myles] in Washington and then later he was with Eddie Mallory

ctx.x: Yes, I knew Elton Hill when he was with Tommy [Myles] in Washington and then later he was with Eddie Mallory at the same time --
Eddie Mallory was married to Ethel Waters --
